# Pekulo — User Flows

**Generated by:** aped-ux
**Date:** 2026-05-03

Flows are mapped from PRD journeys J1–J9. Each flow lists screen entry → events → state changes → screen exit.

---

## J1 — First-run setup ("set the compass")

**PRD reference:** `docs/prd.md#user-journeys` J1
**Status in proto:** stubbed (the proto assumes Alex is past first-run with compass + 1 milestone + 1 account already set)

```
[Auth · Sign in]
       ↓ (Supabase session)
[Dashboard · Cap]
   ├─ if compass setup complete (target capital + horizon + ≥1 milestone + ≥1 account)
   │      → render full dashboard
   └─ if compass setup incomplete (FR-8)
          → render setup CTA in compass widget
              ↓ tap "Définir le cap"
          [Settings · Hypothèse · setCompass]
              ↓
          [Dashboard · Cap] (re-renders with compass data)
```

**Screens involved:** auth (out of proto scope), Cap (Cap view), Settings (Hypothèse section)

---

## J2 — Daily check ("am I on track?")

**PRD reference:** J2 · FR-41 · FR-42 · FR-43 · FR-44 · U1 (≤ 5 s answer)
**Status in proto:** ✅ implemented end-to-end

```
[Open Pekulo]
       ↓
[Dashboard · Cap]
   • Hero: total wealth + delta vs plan (CountUpEUR animation, ≤ 1 s)
   • Compass donut (desktop) / Mini-KPIs (mobile): % progress + remaining
   • Trajectoire 12m chart: actual vs plan
   • Paliers: next milestone with status
   • Hypothèse: projection vs cap-required + verdict
   • Composition: cash / placements / immobilier split
   • Activité récente: 5 latest transactions
       ↓ (one tap)
[Detail screen — Transactions / Mensuel / Portefeuille / Immobilier]
```

**Animations on entry:** Donut sweep 0 → target (900 ms ease-out) ; CountUpEUR spring 0 → value ; paliers stagger entry 40 ms each.

---

## J3 — Monthly closing ("did I beat my plan this month?")

**PRD reference:** J3 · FR-37 · FR-38 · FR-39 · FR-40
**Status in proto:** ✅ implemented (sign-off button is disabled because pending suggestions exist — realistic gating)

```
[Dashboard · Cap]
       ↓ tap bottom nav · Mensuel  /  desktop sidebar · Mensuel
[Mensuel]
   • Hero: mois en cours (Entrées / Sorties / Net)
   • Action: Clôturer mai (disabled if suggestions pending)
       ↓ if all transactions categorised
   • Tap [Clôturer mai] → confirmation modal (forward work — see ConfirmDialog story) → state.signedOff = true
       ↓
   • Historique row gets [Clôturé ✓] badge
       ↓ tap a past month
   [Mensuel · Détail mois] (drilldown — out of proto scope)
       ↓ user can re-open with explicit confirmation (FR-40)
```

**Disabled-state rationale:** the proto demonstrates that closing requires zero pending IA suggestions ; UI displays opacity-50 + cursor-not-allowed + greyed icon.

---

## J4 — Imported transaction → categorised ("LLM does the boring part")

**PRD reference:** J4 · FR-29 · FR-30 · FR-31 · FR-32 · FR-33 · FR-34 · FR-35
**Status in proto:** ✅ implemented as suggestion review UI ; CSV import button is forward work

```
[Transactions]
   • Stats row · "À confirmer" stat (mobile) shows pending count
   • Section "Suggestions IA" lists pending rows
       ↓ each SuggestionRow shows
   • Arrow icon (in/out) · label · account · date · amount
   • Suggested category chip [Sparkles · Alimentation]
   • Confidence: 94 % (route badge: iOS / Ollama / Cloud — hidden < 640 px)
   • Actions: [✓ Confirmer]  [Modifier]
       ↓ tap [✓ Confirmer]
   • Row moves to "Récentes"
   • category persisted (FR-33)
   • llm_log entry recorded (FR-35)
       ↓ tap [Modifier]
   • Open category picker (forward work — shared CategoryPicker component) → user override
   • Override persisted as final category (FR-33)
       ↓ when no more pending
   [Section · EmptyState] "Tout est catégorisé"
```

**Routing transparency (FR-31):** the route badge ("iOS" / "Ollama" / "Cloud") on each suggestion makes the LLM topology visible to the user — supports the EU AI Act transparency obligation (DR-12).

**Third-party opt-in path (FR-34):** the "Cloud" route badge only appears when `USER.thirdPartyLLMOptIn === true`. Settings · IA exposes the toggle ; default `false`.

## J5 — Adding a holding (existing module, extended)

**PRD reference:** J5 · FR-13 → FR-20
**Status in proto:** read-only list (form drafted at story-level)

```
[Portefeuille]
   • Hero: Valeur portefeuille FX-EUR + plus-value latente
   • Répartition: ETF / Actions / Crypto with mini-donuts
   • Lignes: 6 holdings (CW8.PA, PE500.PA, VWCE.DE, AAPL, BTC-EUR, ETH-EUR)
       ↓ tap [+ Ajouter] (mobile contextual button OR HeaderAction in Lignes)
   [Add Holding form] (forward work — aped-arch & aped-epics)
       • ticker, kind {etf | action | crypto | autre}, currency, account
       ↓ submit
   [Lots input] (forward work — see story aped-epics)
       • date, qty, unit price, fees per lot
       ↓ persist
   • System resolves quote via 4-tier provider chain (FR-16)
   [Portefeuille · Lignes] re-renders with new holding
```

---

## J6 — Adding a real-estate property ("the apartment counts")

**PRD reference:** J6 · FR-21 → FR-27
**Status in proto:** read-only single property (Lyon 7e) — form drafted at story-level

```
[Immobilier]
   • Hero: Equity nette · valuation totale · debt remaining
   • Action: [+ Ajouter un bien] (white pill primary)
       ↓ tap
   [Add Property form] (forward work — see story aped-epics)
       • label, type {residence-principale | locatif | autre}, valuation, last-valued date
       • optional mortgage (FR-22)
       • optional rental block (FR-23)
       ↓ submit
   • System derives net equity = valuation − outstanding principal (FR-25)
   • System derives monthly cash-flow if rental (FR-24)
   • Net equity contributes to total wealth + compass progress (FR-26)
   [Immobilier] re-renders with new property card
```

**Display:** each property card shows the % remboursé as a mini-donut (visual completion of the mortgage payoff).

## J7 — Milestone review ("are my checkpoints still realistic?")

**PRD reference:** J7 · FR-3 · FR-4 · FR-6
**Status in proto:** ✅ list view implemented ; CRUD form drafted at story-level

```
[Dashboard · Cap]
   • Section "Paliers" (mobile) / Card "Paliers" (desktop bento)
   • 3 milestones with mini-donut + status badge ("en avance" / "sur la trajectoire" / "en retard")
       ↓ tap [+ Ajouter]
   [Add Milestone form] (forward work — see story aped-epics)
       • target capital, target year (must be < compass horizon)
       ↓ submit
   • System re-computes all milestone statuses (FR-6)
   [Cap dashboard] re-renders ; all curves + paliers recalc
```

**PRD reference:** J8 · FR-53 · FR-54 · FR-55 · FR-56

## J9 — Compass evolution ("my goal moved")

**PRD reference:** J9 · FR-2
**Status in proto:** stubbed — Hypothèse section in Settings displays current values ; edit form drafted at story-level

```
[Settings]
   • Section "Hypothèse de projection"
   • Current versement mensuel + taux supposé (read-only display)
       ↓ tap [Modifier]
   [Edit Hypothesis form] (forward work — see story aped-epics)
       • monthly contribution, assumed rate
       ↓ also exposes:
       • target capital, horizon (compass values)
       ↓ submit
   • System archives prior compass values (FR-2)
   • Milestones recompute proportionally
   • Dashboard surfaces "compass updated on YYYY-MM-DD" annotation
```

## Cross-cutting flows

### Theme switching (FR-51)

```
[Settings · Apparence]
   • SegmentedControl: [Système] [Sombre] [Clair]
       ↓ tap
   • setTheme(value) → ThemeContext
   • applyTheme() toggles `<html class="light">`
   • All tokens swap via CSS variables ; no remount needed
   • If 'system' selected: matchMedia listener watches OS preference live
```

### Language switching (FR-52)

```
[Settings · Apparence]
   • SegmentedControl: [Français] [English]
       ↓ tap (proto-only state — wiring to i18n catalog is forward work)
   • setLang(value) → i18n provider (forward work — i18n provider in aped-arch)
   • All UI strings re-render
   • User preference persisted across sessions + devices
```

### Account deletion (FR-50)

```
[Settings · Vos données]
   • Row "Supprimer mon compte" (destructive — text-loss)
   • Sub: "Cascade sur toutes les tables · irréversible"
       ↓ tap [Trash2 · Supprimer]
   [Confirmation modal] (forward work — shared ConfirmDialog)
       • Type the email to confirm
       ↓ confirm
   • Cascade DELETE across user-scoped tables (FR-50)
   • Supabase Auth user erased
   • Returns within 60 s for Persona #1 volume (NFR-7)
   • Sign out + redirect to /
```

### Data export (FR-49)

```
[Settings · Vos données]
   • Row "Exporter mes données"
   • Sub: "JSON complet · conforme RGPD"
       ↓ tap [Download · Exporter]
   • Server-side: build full JSON dump conforming to docs/exports/schema-v1.json (NFR-30)
   • Returns within 60 s for Persona #1 volume (NFR-6)
       ↓ browser download
   • Filename: pekulo-export-YYYY-MM-DD.json
```

## Navigation graph (sidebar / bottom nav)

```
                   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                   │              Dashboard root             │
                   │  (top tab toggle: Cap | Patrimoine)     │
                   └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                       │
   ┌───────────────┬───────────────────┼───────────────────┬──────────────────┐
   │               │                   │                   │                  │
   ↓               ↓                   ↓                   ↓                  ↓
┌──────┐  ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐
│ Cap  │  │ Transactions │    │   Mensuel    │    │ Portefeuille │   │  Immobilier  │
└──────┘  └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘
   │
   └─→ tap avatar  →  Paramètres (settings — also sidebar bottom on desktop)
```

All transitions go through `<AnimatePresence>` (fade + slide-up 8 → 0, ease-out 200 ms). Reduced-motion users get instant swap.

---

## Out of scope (explicitly not flowed in this UX spec)

- Bank connectivity flows (Powens / Bridge) — V2+ deferred decision (PRD DR-9)
- Crypto exchange API flows — V2+ (PRD DR-10)
- AISP / KYC onboarding — only triggered if PSD2 connectivity is approved
- Push-notification flows (compass-progress digests) — V1.5 mobile work

These are documented here so downstream skills (`aped-arch`, `aped-epics`) can confirm the omission is deliberate.
